list.name: feature_id
list.label: Feature
list.query: WITH option_values AS (SELECT feature_id AS value FROM operation_measurements WHERE feature_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT feature_id FROM service_events WHERE feature_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT value FROM option_values UNION ALL SELECT '__no_matching_values__' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM option_values) ORDER BY 1

list.name: operation
list.label: Operation
list.query: WITH option_values AS (SELECT DISTINCT operation AS value FROM operation_measurements) SELECT value FROM option_values UNION ALL SELECT '__no_matching_values__' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM option_values) ORDER BY 1

list.name: pid
list.label: PID
list.query: WITH option_values AS (SELECT pid::text AS value FROM operation_measurements UNION SELECT pid::text FROM service_events) SELECT value FROM option_values UNION ALL SELECT '__no_matching_values__' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM option_values) ORDER BY 1

list.name: source_id
list.label: Source
list.query: WITH option_values AS (SELECT source_id AS value FROM operation_measurements WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT source_id FROM service_events WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT value FROM option_values UNION ALL SELECT '__no_matching_values__' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM option_values) ORDER BY 1

list.name: status
list.label: Status
list.query: WITH option_values AS (SELECT DISTINCT status AS value FROM operation_measurements) SELECT value FROM option_values UNION ALL SELECT '__no_matching_values__' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM option_values) ORDER BY 1

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: WITH option_values AS (SELECT DISTINCT service AS value FROM service_events) SELECT value FROM option_values UNION ALL SELECT '__no_matching_values__' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM option_values) ORDER BY 1

list.name: severity
list.label: Severity
list.query: WITH option_values AS (SELECT DISTINCT severity AS value FROM service_events) SELECT value FROM option_values UNION ALL SELECT '__no_matching_values__' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM option_values) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", feature_id, operation, pid, source_id, sequence, audio_seconds, inference_seconds, rtf, status FROM operation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND ('${feature_id:raw}' = '__all' OR feature_id IN (${feature_id:sqlstring})) AND ('${operation:raw}' = '__all' OR operation IN (${operation:sqlstring})) AND ('${pid:raw}' = '__all' OR pid::text IN (${pid:sqlstring})) AND ('${source_id:raw}' = '__all' OR source_id IN (${source_id:sqlstring})) AND ('${status:raw}' = '__all' OR status IN (${status:sqlstring})) ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 2000

SELECT recorded_at AS time, rtf, feature_id || '/' || operation || ' · PID ' || pid::text || ' · ' || COALESCE(source_id,'') AS metric FROM operation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND rtf IS NOT NULL AND ('${feature_id:raw}' = '__all' OR feature_id IN (${feature_id:sqlstring})) AND ('${operation:raw}' = '__all' OR operation IN (${operation:sqlstring})) AND ('${pid:raw}' = '__all' OR pid::text IN (${pid:sqlstring})) AND ('${source_id:raw}' = '__all' OR source_id IN (${source_id:sqlstring})) ORDER BY recorded_at
SELECT recorded_at AS time, cpu_percent AS "CPU %" FROM host_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND cpu_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

SELECT recorded_at AS time, memory_used_bytes AS "Physical used", memory_total_bytes AS "Physical total", swap_used_bytes AS "Swap used", swap_total_bytes AS "Swap total" FROM host_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at

SELECT recorded_at AS time, cpu_percent, role || ' · ' || COALESCE(source_id,'') || ' · PID ' || pid::text AS metric FROM process_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND cpu_percent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

SELECT recorded_at AS time, rss_bytes, role || ' · ' || COALESCE(source_id,'') || ' · PID ' || pid::text AS metric FROM process_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND rss_bytes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

panels.title: Telemetry writer queue and dropped records

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, queue_depth, dropped_count, write_failures FROM writer_health WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at

SELECT recorded_at AS "time", service, feature_id, severity, event_name, pid, source_id, attributes FROM service_events WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND ('${service:raw}' = '__all' OR service IN (${service:sqlstring})) AND ('${feature_id:raw}' = '__all' OR feature_id IN (${feature_id:sqlstring})) AND ('${severity:raw}' = '__all' OR severity IN (${severity:sqlstring})) AND ('${pid:raw}' = '__all' OR pid::text IN (${pid:sqlstring})) AND ('${source_id:raw}' = '__all' OR source_id IN (${source_id:sqlstring})) ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT $__timeGroup(recorded_at,'1m') AS time, count(*)::double precision AS errors, service || '/' || COALESCE(feature_id,'service') AS metric FROM service_events WHERE $__timeFilter(recorded_at) AND severity='error' AND ('${service:raw}' = '__all' OR service IN (${service:sqlstring})) AND ('${feature_id:raw}' = '__all' OR feature_id IN (${feature_id:sqlstring})) AND ('${pid:raw}' = '__all' OR pid::text IN (${pid:sqlstring})) AND ('${source_id:raw}' = '__all' OR source_id IN (${source_id:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,3 ORDER BY 1
